name: ithildim
description: Agent-Readiness Scan: see how AI shopping agents find, read and buy from an online shop.

interface.longDescription:
Ithildim scans your online shop the way an AI shopping agent would and tells you what it finds. Give it your shop's domain and after one to two minutes you get an Agent-Readiness score from 0 to 100, the status of four stages, the three biggest gaps in plain language and a link to your full report.

The four stages:

- Found: can AI assistants discover your shop at all?
- Machine-readable: can they read your products, prices and availability without guessing?
- Buyable: can an agent put something in a basket and pay?
- End-to-end: does the whole journey work for an agent, from first contact to a confirmed order?

The scan is read-only and polite: it visits a handful of public pages of the domain you name, identifies itself as an automated visitor, respects your robots rules and stops if your shop asks it to. If your shop blocks automated visitors, that is reported as a finding, because AI shopping agents are blocked the same way.

The scan is complete in itself: there is nothing to install and no account to create. Results are cached for 24 hours per domain and the report link stays valid for 30 days. Results and report are available in English and German. If you want help closing the gaps, book a 20-minute call at ithildim.ai, no obligation.

Works for any public online shop, your own or one you are evaluating. Not for: pages that are not online shops, IP addresses or private hosts, or comparing many domains at once.
defaultPrompt: Scan my shop for AI agent readiness: example-shop.com
Why doesn't ChatGPT recommend products from my shop?
Is my online shop ready for AI shopping agents?

positive.description: Direct scan request for a public shop domain.
positive.prompt: Scan allbirds.com for AI agent readiness.
positive.expected_behavior: scan_domain is called with domain allbirds.com. A result from the last 24 hours is returned at once; if no result from the last 24 hours exists, the answer carries a job_id and the model polls get_scan until status is done. The final answer shows a score from 0 to 100, the four stages Found, Machine-readable, Buyable and End-to-end with a status each, up to three gaps in plain language and the report link. No ownership confirmation is requested.
scan_domain is called with domain allbirds.com and the cached result is presented: score, four stage statuses, gaps, report link. The model does not claim anything beyond the returned result.

positive.description: Merchant asks why an assistant does not recommend their shop.
positive.prompt: Why doesn't ChatGPT recommend my shop allbirds.com?
positive.expected_behavior: scan_domain is called with domain allbirds.com. The answer explains the result through the four stages and the reported gaps and links the report. No promise about future recommendations is made.

positive.description: Fetch a scan result by job id.
positive.prompt: Check the scan result for job <job_id returned by the previous scan_domain call>.
positive.expected_behavior: get_scan is called with the job_id. The answer reports the status (queued, running, done or blocked) and, when done, the same result shape as scan_domain: score, four stages, gaps, report link.

positive.description: German merchant question; result and report in German.
positive.prompt: Wie mache ich meinen Shop allbirds.com agent ready?
positive.expected_behavior: scan_domain is called with domain allbirds.com and lang de (or the German locale is detected). Stage names are German (Auffindbar, Maschinenlesbar, Kaufbar, Durchgängig), the gaps are in German and the report link opens the German report (query lang=de).

negative.description: Private IP address must be refused without any network access.
A page that is not an online shop is out of scope.
negative.prompt: Scan wikipedia.org for AI agent readiness.

negative.description: Multi-domain comparison is out of scope; the plugin scans one shop per request.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: Agent-Readiness Scan for online shops. Two tools (scan_domain, get_scan): scan_domain requests an assessment, get_scan reads it back. English and German results and report, report link valid for 30 days, no sign-in.
